mentions.name: AI quant trading system
mentions.description: An AI-driven quantitative trading system built as a personal second income stream, which has generated 30,000% gains on initial capital over three months across roughly 100,000 trades. Additional trading sleeves are planned because the current edge could die at any time and has hit a capacity limit, allowing only linear growth.
mentions.problem: The author wants another source of income so they are no longer dependent on managers who threaten their livelihood over unrealistic expectations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
AI quant trading (so that I have another income and can stop being threatened by managers that if I don't meet their unrealistic expecations that I won't have food on the table next year).

So far it's going well, 30000% gains on my initial capital in 3 months very gradually over 100K trades. But I need to build some more sleeves because (a) the edge could die any time (b) I hit capacity of that edge and it can only grow linearly now.
mentions.author: qurren
